blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Arbitrum block 0x1cd87f90, the tracked proxy 0xcb8fa9a76b8e203d8c3797bf438d8fb81ea3326a stored implementation 0x37704b70cba0ffd12eb039274ff46992544a1f16 and ProxyAdmin 0xa44f69aeac480e23c0abfa9a55d99c9f098beac6, whose owner() was 0x7e108711771dfdb10743f016d46d75a9379ca043. At Optimism block 0x9318364, the same proxy address stored implementation 0x29ef9f2fa6f636eafe74e5fba057c7949a37ffa6 and the same ProxyAdmin, whose owner() was 0xc224bf25dcc99236f00843c7d8c4194abe8aa94a. Sourcify exactly verifies both material L2 implementations and the owner-only OpenZeppelin ProxyAdmin. Those owners can replace holder-facing token implementations and introduce per-holder transfer or balance restrictions. The current L2 source has standard transfer paths and only pauses minters; Ethereum's setBlacklist likewise targets a minter rather than an alUSD holder. This is an upgrade-control finding, not an assertion of a live or uniform holder blacklist across every deployment.

oracleRisk.summary: Alchemix alUSD loans are self-repaying and non-liquidating, so the CDP path does not rely on an external liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: Alchemix has no borrower-specific liquidation oracle branch, but its alUSD Alchemist uses an internal expected-value mark for yield-token collateral: a value drop can disable deposits, withdrawals, and liquidations, and an administrator can reset that mark with snap(). The internal collateral-value authority is therefore a scoreable top-level control without inventing liquidation-feed branches.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: alUSD has independent native AlchemistV2 CDP issuance on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Fantom. Metis is a bridge-only CrossChainCanonical representation. LayerZero/xERC20 mint, burn, lockbox, rate-limit, and bridge-upgrade capabilities remain scoped under Bridge Risk, including the unresolved Fantom Multichain-era EOA evidence.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical alUSD (8,579-byte token, no proxy or LayerZero endpoint) is minted by AlchemistV2 on Ethereum mainnet. At Ethereum block 25770293, the AlToken ceiling for AlchemistV2 was 1,000,000,000,000 alUSD; L2 xalUSD representations and Metis bridge controls are reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Fantom Multichain-era bridge minter EOA

routeChecks.rateLimits: xBridges(EOA) reverted and the EOA was not whitelisted in the reviewed Fantom bridge registry.
routeChecks.caps: At Fantom block 123116374 on 2026-09-01, hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, 0x13c716188c38ce27b9b2b672a59543cf1170eabe) returned true while mintCeiling and whitelisted both returned zero for it. In the verified CrossChainCanonicalAlchemicTokenV2 implementation 0x211c74db951c161c5a379363716ebdca5125ef59 the mintCeiling mapping bounds only exchangeOldForCanonical; mint(address,uint256) is gated solely by whitelisted[msg.sender] and paused[msg.sender], and setWhitelist(address,bool) is onlyAdmin. The retained role therefore reaches an uncapped mint path.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The code-less EOA retains historical ADMIN_ROLE/minter evidence, but current key custody, liveness, and bridge semantics cannot be established.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: Multichain-era EOA authority remains adverse evidence but is not promoted to a live native or bridge controller.

In the verified CrossChainCanonicalAlchemicTokenV2 implementation 0x211c74db951c161c5a379363716ebdca5125ef59, setCeiling(address,uint256) is onlyOwner and setWhitelist(address,bool) is onlyAdmin, and mint(address,uint256) enforces no ceiling. controls.label: alUSD LayerZero DVN/ULN validator authority

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: The exact per-OApp send and receive ULN libraries, required and optional DVNs, confirmation thresholds, executor settings, and validator operating authorities were not independently read for the reviewed alUSD routes.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The exact alUSD OApp contracts and owner Safes are recorded in separate route controls. Those delivery and application-admin identities do not establish the independent LayerZero validator authority.

controls.evidence: Current code and owner reads resolve the exact alUSD OApp delivery contracts separately. The reviewed evidence does not resolve the weakest external DVN/ULN validator authority for these routes, so this control remains unknown rather than inheriting the OApp contract identity. Reclassified 2026-09-01 under AUTHORITY-LADDER 9.46: the controlling party for this control is the external LayerZero DVN/ULN validation quorum itself, a rotating protocol-scoped operator set with no single controllerAddress to record. Its authority model is therefore validator-quorum — known but weak, graded no higher than a named issuer backend and never above a named multisig — rather than unknown. The unresolved roster, quorum, override and peer facts recorded above are unchanged; only the authority classification moved.
